settings.form.siteTitle.label: Site name
settings.form.siteUrl.label: Public URL
settings.form.siteUrl.help: The public address users reach this site at. Used in Plex sign-in redirects — set this to avoid exposing your server IP.
settings.form.deletionVote.label: Vote threshold
settings.form.deletionVote.help: When a library item reaches this many deletion votes, admins are notified via email, push, and Discord. Set to 0 to disable notifications.
settings.form.maintenance.messagePlaceho: We're performing some maintenance. Please check back shortly.
settings.form.auditRetention.label: PII retention (days)
settings.form.auditRetention.help: Audit rows older than this have their IP address, device, and user name redacted (and login-event details cleared) by the daily scrub job. The rows themselves are kept. Leave blank for the default of 90 days; minimum 7.
settings.form.request4kAll.title: Allow everyone to request 4K
settings.form.request4kAll.help: When on, any user who can request a given media type can also request it in 4K — no per-user “Request 4K” permission needed. When off, 4K requires the per-user permission (or admin). Either way a 4K Radarr/Sonarr instance must be configured above.
settings.form.ratingsVisibility.title: Visible rating badges
settings.form.ratingsVisibility.help: Untick a source to hide its badge everywhere ratings render (detail pages, cards, the admin request list). Hiding a badge doesn't stop the data being fetched.
settings.form.jellyfinRestrict.title: Restrict Jellyfin sign-in to known members
settings.form.jellyfinRestrict.help: Only Jellyfin accounts that already exist on this instance — synced library users or anyone who has signed in before — may sign in. New, unknown Jellyfin accounts are refused until a library sync adds them. Disabling this lets any valid Jellyfin credential create an account (not recommended).
settings.form.disableLocalLogin.title: Disable local login
settings.form.disableLocalLogin.help: Hides the password sign-in form and blocks local registration. Users must sign in via an external provider (Plex, Jellyfin, or SSO/OIDC). Make sure at least one external provider is configured before enabling.
settings.form.userEmails.title: Send notification emails
settings.form.userEmails.help: When enabled, users receive emails for approved, declined, and available events (based on their own preferences) and admins receive new request, issue, and deletion-vote alerts. When disabled, no notification emails are sent (saving the settings above still sends a configuration test email).
settings.form.quota.limitHelp: Maximum requests per user in the period. Set to 0 to disable.
settings.form.motd.showHelp: Disable to hide the popup without clearing the message content.
settings.form.requireAdminMfa.title: Prompt administrators to set up two-factor
settings.form.requireAdminMfa.help: Administrators who sign in with a password and have no second factor are redirected to set one up when they open an admin page. This is a nudge, not a lock: signing in is never blocked, and the API, the app and the rest of the site keep working without two-factor.
settings.form.requireAdminMfa.envOverrid: Currently switched off by {env} on the server.
settings.form.apiKey.omdb.label: OMDB API Key
settings.form.apiKey.omdb.help: Enables IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes ratings on all detail pages. Get a free key at {link}.
settings.form.apiKey.ipinfo.label: ipinfo.io Access Token
settings.form.apiKey.ipinfo.help: Resolves stream IPs to city, ISP, and approximate location on the activity pages. Get a free token at {link} — free tier: 50,000 lookups/month. Results are cached per IP for 30 days.
settings.form.apiKey.mdblist.label: MDBList API Key
settings.form.apiKey.mdblist.help: Adds RT Audience Score and Trakt ratings, and improves TV show coverage. Get a free key at {link} (Account → API). Free tier: 1,000 req/day.
settings.form.apiKey.trakt.label: Trakt Client ID
settings.form.apiKey.trakt.help: Adds Trakt popular and trending lists to the Top Rated page. Create a free app at {link} and copy the Client ID.
settings.form.ratingsWarm.fullSyncTitle: Purge all MDBList sentinels and re-fetch the entire library
settings.form.session.help: Desktop default: 3600 (1 h). Mobile default: 604800 (7 days). Remember me: 2592000 (30 days). A session lasts its full configured duration — there is no inactivity timeout — and the iOS app stays signed in until the session is revoked. Changes apply to new logins only.
settings.form.announce.confirmTitle: Send an "Update Summonarr" notification to every registered iOS device?
settings.form.announce.confirmHelp: This goes to all users' iOS devices at once and cannot be recalled. Limited to 2 sends per hour.
settings.form.announce.button: Send update notice to all iOS devices
settings.form.announce.help: Pushes a generic "a new version is available on the App Store" alert to every iOS device registered on this server.
settings.form.donation.zellePlaceholder: Email or phone number registered with Zelle
settings.form.donation.bmacPlaceholder: your-bmac-handle or full Buy Me a Coffee URL
settings.form.rateLimit.help: Each limit must be between 1 and 10000 — these limiters cannot be turned off.
settings.form.rateLimit.pushHelp: Maximum push-notification devices per account. Oldest is evicted automatically. Set to 0 for no limit.
settings.form.iosPush.relayUrlHelp: Must be https://. Leave blank to use the default relay operated by the app publisher.
settings.form.iosPush.relayKeyHelp: Sent as a Bearer token on every relay request when the relay requires auth (8–200 characters, no spaces). A key also gives this server its own per-device rate-limit budget on the relay, so use a distinct key for each server.
settings.form.iosPush.keyIsSet: A key is currently set — click Remove and Save to clear it.
settings.form.iosPush.recommendedBuildHe: iOS builds below this number show a dismissible update prompt after sign-in. Leave blank to disable.
settings.form.machineSession.title: Machine session API
settings.form.machineSession.help: Allow {endpoint} to issue short-lived admin sessions via {secret}. Used for automated screenshot capture and headless browser access.
settings.form.machineSession.ipsHelp: Restrict which client IPs may mint a session. One or more IPs or CIDR ranges, comma or newline separated (e.g. {example}). {required} — the API cannot be enabled while this is empty, so set it before turning the switch on. Requires {trustProxy} and a reverse proxy that sets {header} — otherwise every request is rejected.
settings.form.webhookSecret.placeholder: Leave blank to turn this webhook off
settings.form.webhookSecret.label: {service} webhook secret
settings.form.webhookSecret.help: Used by the {service} webhook endpoint. Falls back to the legacy secret below if blank.
settings.form.webhookSecret.help4k: Used by the 4K {service} instance's webhook. Set only if you run a separate 4K {service}.
settings.form.webhookSecret.legacyLabel: Legacy webhook secret (fallback — to be removed in a future release)
settings.form.webhookSecret.legacyHelp: Shared fallback used when a source-specific secret above is blank. Prefer the per-source secrets; this field will be removed in a future release.
settings.form.webhookUrls.loadFailed: Couldn’t load the token — try again.
settings.form.webhookUrls.secretNeeded: Set the 4K webhook secret above to generate this URL.
settings.form.webhookUrls.label: {service} webhook URL
settings.form.webhookUrls.noSecret: No secret token set — Radarr/Sonarr webhook calls will be rejected until you set a token above.
settings.form.webhookUrls.help: In Radarr/Sonarr: Settings → Connect → + → Webhook · Method: POST · Events: On Import + On Manual Interaction Required + On Movie Delete / On Series Delete + On Movie File Delete · Use the URLs above (token is included). 4K rows point at the same endpoint with the 4K instance's own token.
settings.form.email.fromHelp: Leave blank to use the username as the sender.
settings.form.email.resendKeyHelp: Create one at {link}. Keys are stored encrypted.
settings.form.email.resendFromHelp: Must be a sender on a domain verified in your Resend account.
settings.form.libraryMatch.loadHint: Click "Load examples" to see sample paths.
settings.form.libraryMatch.loadFailed: Couldn't load sample paths — check that Plex/Jellyfin are configured and reachable.
settings.form.libraryMatch.intro: Strip prefixes per server and media type so relative paths align when comparing Plex and Jellyfin for bad-match detection.
settings.form.cache.desc.tmdb: Titles, overviews, genres, country, language, keywords, watch providers. Also resets grid metadata and the For You suggestion graph.
settings.form.cache.desc.mdblist: IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes, Audience, Metacritic, Trakt, Letterboxd ratings.
settings.form.cache.desc.omdb: IMDb rating fallback when MDBList has no key configured.
settings.form.cache.title: Cache Management
settings.form.cache.intro: Clear and refetch each metadata source. Clearing forces fresh data on the next page visit; refetch warms the cache for your whole library now. After changing API keys, clear then refetch.
settings.form.library.loadHint: Click "Save & Test" to load libraries from your {server} server.
settings.form.library.noLibraries: No movie or TV libraries found.
settings.form.library.noneSelected: No libraries selected — all libraries will be synced.
settings.form.jellyfin.apiKeyPlaceholder: Generate one in Jellyfin → Dashboard → API Keys
settings.form.jellyfin.apiKeyHelp: Generate an API key under Jellyfin Dashboard → Advanced → API Keys.
settings.form.jellyfin.syncFailed: Sync failed — check server URL and API key
settings.form.arr.optionsFailed: Could not load options — check your connection above.
settings.form.arr.minimumAvailabilityHel: When added movies count as available to search — e.g. “Released” waits for a digital/physical release instead of grabbing early rips.
settings.form.arr.languageProfileHelp: Applied to series added by approved requests (Sonarr v3 — v4 handles language via custom formats instead).
settings.form.arr.importHelpMovies: Scans your {service} library and caches which movies are monitored but not yet downloaded. Run this once after connecting, then keep it up-to-date via the webhook or a scheduled sync.
settings.form.arr.importHelpTv: Scans your {service} library and caches which TV shows are monitored but not yet downloaded. Run this once after connecting, then keep it up-to-date via the webhook or a scheduled sync.
settings.form.plex.startFailed: Could not start Plex sign-in. Please try again.
settings.form.plex.storeFailed: Could not store sign-in state. Disable private browsing and try again.
settings.form.plex.intro: Connect your Plex admin account. Only users you share your Plex server with will be able to sign in.
settings.form.plex.serverUrlHelp: Local address of your Plex Media Server — used to sync library availability.
settings.form.discord.savedRestart: Saved · Restart the bot for changes to take effect
settings.form.discord.guide.title: Setup guide
settings.form.discord.guide.s1.title: 1. Create a Discord application
settings.form.discord.guide.s1.body: Go to the Discord Developer Portal and create a new application.
settings.form.discord.guide.s2.title: 2. Get the Bot Token
settings.form.discord.guide.s2.body: Go to {bot} in the left sidebar. Click {reset} and copy the value — paste it into the {field} field below.
settings.form.discord.guide.s2.note: Also check that {grant} is {off} — if enabled, the invite URL will fail with a "code grant" error.
settings.form.discord.guide.s3.title: 3. Copy the Client ID and Public Key
settings.form.discord.guide.s3.body: Go to {page}. Copy the {appId} into the Client ID field below, and copy the {publicKey} into the Public Key field below. The Public Key is required to verify that interactions come from Discord.
settings.form.discord.guide.s4.title: 4. Set the Guild (Server) ID
settings.form.discord.guide.s4.body: Enable {devMode} in Discord user settings (Appearance → Advanced). Right-click your server icon and select {copyId}. Paste it in the {field} field below.
settings.form.discord.guide.s4.note: Required — without it, commands are registered globally and take up to 1 hour to appear.
settings.form.discord.guide.s5.title: 5. Save settings & register slash commands
settings.form.discord.guide.s5.body: Save the fields below, then click {register} below. You should see a confirmation that commands were registered to your guild.
settings.form.discord.guide.s6.title: 6. Set the Interactions Endpoint URL
settings.form.discord.guide.s6.body: Go back to {page} in the Developer Portal. Set the {field} to:
settings.form.discord.guide.s6.note: Discord will send a verification ping — your app must respond with a valid PONG for the URL to be accepted. Make sure the Public Key is saved first (step 3). Click {save}.
settings.form.discord.guide.s7.title: 7. Invite the bot to your server
settings.form.discord.guide.s7.body: Go to {generator}. Check the {bot} and {commands} scopes. Under Bot Permissions check {send}, {embed}, and {view}. Copy the {url} and open it to add the bot to your server.
settings.form.discord.guide.s7.note: Use the OAuth2 URL Generator — do not use the "Discord Provided Link" from the Installation page.
settings.form.discord.guide.s8.title: 8. Set up a notification channel
settings.form.discord.guide.s8.body: Instead of sending approval and download notifications as DMs, the bot can post them in a dedicated channel and ping the user with an {mention}.
settings.form.discord.guide.s8.step1: In Discord, create or choose a channel (e.g. {a} or {b}).
settings.form.discord.guide.s8.step2: Right-click the channel → {edit} → {perms}. Make sure the bot role has {view} and {send} enabled. If the channel is private, you must explicitly add the bot role.
settings.form.discord.guide.s8.step5: Paste it into the {field} field below and save.
settings.form.discord.guide.s8.note: Leave the field blank to keep using DMs instead. When a channel is set, every notification is posted there as {format} so the user gets a ping.
settings.form.discord.guide.cmdRequest: Search and request a movie or TV show — no account linking required
settings.form.discord.guide.cmdLink: Link your Discord account to your web account — generate the token on your Profile page
settings.form.discord.botTokenHelp: From the Bot page of your Discord application (step 2).
settings.form.discord.guildIdHelp: Your Discord server ID (step 4). Required for instant slash command registration.
settings.form.discord.publicKeyHelp: From General Information → Public Key (step 3). Required for HTTP interaction signature verification.
settings.form.discord.autoApproveRolesHe: Comma-separated Discord role IDs. Members with any of these roles will have their requests auto-approved and sent to download — without admin review. Right-click a role in Discord (Developer Mode on) to copy its ID.
settings.form.discord.requireLinked: Require linked site account for Discord requests
settings.form.discord.requireLinkedHelp: When enabled, Discord users must link their account via {link} before using {request} or {status}. Members with an Auto-Approve role are exempt — they can request without linking.
settings.form.discord.requireLinkedSite: Require linked Discord account for site requests
settings.form.discord.requireLinkedSiteH: When enabled, users logged into the site must also link a Discord account before they can submit requests. Leave off to allow site users to request without Discord.
settings.form.discord.adminChannelHelp: Optional. When set, every new pending request is posted to this channel as an embed with {approve} and {decline} buttons.
settings.form.discord.welcomeChannelHelp: Optional. When set, {link} can only be used in this channel, and {request} / {status} are blocked there.
settings.form.discord.notifyChannelHelp: Optional. Approval and download notifications post here and the user is pinged with {mention}. Leave blank to send DMs.
settings.form.discord.inviteUrlHelp: Optional. Permanent invite link. When set, users without a linked Discord account are prompted to join.
settings.form.discord.linkedRoleHelp: Optional. Assigned to every user when they link their Discord account — grants access to general server channels.
settings.form.discord.plexRoleHelp: Optional. Assigned to users who linked via a Plex account.
settings.form.discord.jellyfinRoleHelp: Optional. Assigned to users who linked via a Jellyfin account.
settings.form.discord.adminRoleHelp: Optional. Assigned to Admin-role users when they link.
settings.form.discord.issueAdminRoleHelp: Optional. Assigned to Issue Admin-role users when they link.
settings.form.discord.registerHelp: Re-registers slash commands with Discord. Run this after changing Guild ID or Bot Token.
settings.form.discord.syncRolesHelp: Assigns the Linked, Plex, and Jellyfin roles to all users who have already linked their Discord account. Run this once after configuring role IDs to backfill existing users.
